work_completed: Design study (owner: 'design still amateur, study more'): critique of current captures, Material 3/Gboard/LatinIME/AOSP references and measurable decisions D1–D7 in apps/lunet2d/docs/research/design-produto-2026-11-25.md.

D1: code editor is AvaloniaEdit 12.0.0 (MIT) — line numbers, C# highlighting recoloured for the dark theme, caret line; IME off on the TextArea, the Lunet keyboard edits the Document (one undo step). Notes keep a TextBox with the system keyboard.

D2: keyboard redesigned — one 44 dp strip with icon tabs and suggestions for the word being typed (API + game types and members), letter keys vs modifier keys, accent Enter, preview bubble, accents above the key on hold, 50 dp rows.
D7: haptic hooks (KeyboardTap, Confirm) wired in ShellActivity.

verification.check: Lunet xUnit suite (1257 tests, incl. editor, suggestions, keyboard contrast)

known_issues: Not tested on a physical device: key feel, bubble timing, haptics and AvaloniaEdit touch selection.
